ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, \(C\) is the midpoint of segment \(AB\), \(D\) is a point on \(CB\), \(E\) is the midpoint of segment \(DB\), \(EB = 1\,cm\), and \(EB = \frac{1}{5}AB\), then what is the length of segment \(CE\) in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $EB=1\text{cm}$, and $EB=\frac{1}{5}AB$,\\
it follows that $AB=5EB=5\text{cm}$, \\
Since C is the midpoint of the segment $AB$, \\
we have $CB=\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{5}{2}\text{cm}$, \\
thus $CE=CB-EB=\frac{5}{2}-1=\boxed{\frac{3}{2}}\text{cm}$.
